host.label: Management IP address or hostname
host.description: Specify the IP address or hostname of the data source

port.label: Host port
port.description: Set the port number that is associated with the hostname or IP address

help.label: Need additional help?
help.description: More details on the data source setting can be found in the specified link

result_limit.label: Result size limit
result_limit.description: The maximum number of banner records returned by a search. Criminal IP returns 10 records per API call and allows at most 10,000 records per query. Valid input range is {{min}} to {{max}}.

timeout.label: Query response timeout limit
timeout.description: The limit on how long to wait for the data source response, in seconds. Valid input range is {{min}} to {{max}}.

max_api_calls.label: Maximum API calls per results request
max_api_calls.description: Upper bound on the number of Criminal IP API calls made for one results request. Each call consumes credits: a banner search call returns up to 10 records, an IP lookup costs 2 calls per IP and a domain lookup 1-2 calls per domain. Valid input range is {{min}} to {{max}}.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: Criminal IP API key, sent in the x-api-key header
